tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) to boil, foam, foam up, ferment
1a) (Qal) to boil, foam up
1b) (Poalal) to be troubled, be in turmoil
(Qal) to daub, seal up, cover or smear with asphalt

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to boil up; hence, to ferment (with scum); to glow (with redness); to smear with pitch
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; also  as denominative (from H2564 (חֵמָר))
